name: reflective carapace
desc:
Any time the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is targeted by a magic missile spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a d6. On a 1 to 5, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is unaffected.
On a 6, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, turning the caster into the target.
